title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theater on 1986-04-22
source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; Sennheiser MD421's + Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns; (PAS/Section CTR, Row MM, Seat 15/6 Feet High)> Sony MX 10>Sony TC-D5M, Tapes Maxell MX; Transfer Information:Tascam 112 MKII (XLR Out)>Tascam HD-P2 @ 24/48> HDD>Amadeus Pro (Tracking/Fades/FLAC8); Tracks Renamed/Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename By Keo

ai_review.summary: Excellent recording that captures a powerful show highlighted by a sweet Box of Rain → Visions of Johanna intro and an outrageous Bird Song.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear tape, noting how the box‑to‑visions transition is “so sweet” and describing the overall sound as impressive. Musically the band delivers with power and grace, delivering a standout Visions of Johanna intro, a fiery Bird Song and a beautifully rendered Box of Rain.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4‑5) and uniformly positive comments about both performance and audio quality indicate a strong show with excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the tape as “excellent” and “impressed,” noting crisp clarity especially on the Box → Visions transition; no major flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid, straightforward set list executed with power and grace; highlights flow naturally from Box of Rain into the Visions intro and a high‑energy Bird Song.
